name: Harvard FCU Platinum Rewards Mastercard

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for the first 12 billing cycles on purchases and balance transfers (2% balance transfer fee), then 15.24% to 18.00% variable APR based on creditworthiness.

fx_fee.notes: 1% of the U.S. dollar amount of each transaction made outside the United States.

base_rate.description: 1% base rewards on all other net purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is issued as a statement credit or a deposit to a Harvard FCU checking or savings account; travel and merchandise rewards are also available. Points do not expire.

signup_bonus.description: 10,000 bonus points after $500 in purchases in the first 90 days of card membership.

notes: Mastercard is named without a network package, so network_tier is none.
